resources.string: New sessions use this model and these parameters; each session can still adjust them.
Only affects sessions created later, from Home or with /new.
New sessions use globally enabled skills. Tap to manage.
MCP servers that new sessions connect to by default. Only globally enabled and allowed servers are listed.
No MCP servers available yet. Add one in Settings › MCP servers.
When a session turns tools off, retrieval runs every turn automatically and the knowledge base is not mounted.
Searches once with your exact words before each reply. Suits plain chat and models without tool calling.
No upfront search; the agent calls the knowledge search tool, so the first token arrives sooner. The model may skip a search it needs.
Searches every turn, and the agent can run its own follow-up queries. Background is there from the first turn; the first token is not faster.
The knowledge base is not mounted. You can still mount it from the external folders panel.
The agent asks when it needs full documents; after you approve, the knowledge base is mounted read-only for this session.
New sessions mount the knowledge base read-only when created, without asking each time.
The value on the right is the widest scope a session can choose; new session defaults only affect sessions created later. Retrieval parameters are set in %1$s.
Parameter presets are shared globally and saved per model. Renaming, overwriting, or deleting one affects every agent and session using it.

plurals.item: Closes %d session first, then deletes the agent. This can\'t be undone.
Closes %d sessions first, then deletes the agent. This can\'t be undone.
